newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk shares drop 0.6 pct due to resistance.
newsitem.headline: Turk shares drop 0.6 pct due to resistance.

text.p: Istanbul shares posted losses in afternoon selling on Wednesday after failing to overcome resistance awaited at the index's 1,670-1,680 range for the third day in a row, brokers said.
The IMKB National-100 closed at 1,649, down 10 points, or 0.6 percent from Tuesday. It brushed a high 1,681 in early trade before diving to 1,636 towards the close.
Trade volume jumped to 33.14 trillion lira ($232.5 million) from Tuesday's 28.18 trillion ($198.4 million).
"The index retreated because it could not pierce the 1,670-1,680 band," said Mirsat Vardar from Info securities.

The index had soared four percent in the past two days, disregarding the possibility of early polls, after last week's 8.7 percent rally sparked by hopes of an alternative alliance to replace the troubled Islamist-conservative coalition.
Brokers said selective activity focused on bluechip shares of energy and state firms in an attempt to maintain market momentum and May inflation data announced early on Wednesday were disregarded.

"The concentration of turnover in energy and state firms was noticeable. I do not await sharp falls because the chance of early elections has decreased. The index may drift sideways until the end of the week," said Melih Pastutmaz from Bayindir securities.
